description: Springer Nature's journal class. Not on CTAN: sn-jnl.cls is from the publisher's journal article template package (December 2024), the zip its requirement document names. Options as the template's default (sn-article.tex:65): pdflatex only stops the class loading breakurl, which writes dvips PostScript. The class calls amsmath's \allowdisplaybreaks at \begin{document} and leaves loading amsmath to the document, as the template does. Two more preamble lines (batch 1, round 2, from GitHub run 41584963423): (1) the kernel's \cline (latex.ltx l.16972) is restored: sn-jnl.cls l.1321 lets \cline be booktabs' \cmidrule, which nothing has defined yet when the class loads, so \cline was undefined in every document ('Undefined control sequence \abShortLine ->\cline' in awesomebox's block, and arydshln saved the undefined \cline as \adl@org@cline). (2) \labelitemi leaves vertical mode first: sn-jnl.cls l.1118 makes it \raise1pt\hbox{\textbullet}, and \raise cannot start a paragraph, so an inline list (paralist's inparaitem) whose label began a paragraph stopped at 'You can't use \raise in vertical mode'. In a list's label box \leavevmode does nothing.
